records.title: P9.0.6.3 (audit-only): final 85-case semantic review after exact OSM reconciliation
records.body: Final read-only semantic reevaluation of 85 contested/de facto administrative claims, after merged P9.0.6.2 #316 and historical polygon closure #317. Adds per-ID evidence and role classification (69 unique 2023 named localities, 11 repeated/homonym roles, 4 historic aliases, 1 Lunga microraion conflict); all 85 candidate geometries now exactly aligned with pinned OSM and 84 border cases historically closed. Visually reviewed signed 4-page de facto Law 114-ЗИД-VIII dated 29 May 2026, SHA-256 c9d05f579677f176007bd6987bf11031c986299e180d9e98577715f7cb1cc566: article 3 starts effectiveness after 6 months from official publication, so not operative on 15 Oct 2026; law modifies classification procedures and does not itself enact a named Annex 1 reparenting. This law does not independently close all registry amendment chains or prove effective polygon-wide control. All 85 remain BLOCKED_INCOMPLETE; P9.1_IMPORT_DENIED, never overwrite legal MD CUATM parent. Adds reproducible fail-closed validator and audit-only CI, no geometries, data/current, production policy or candidate lifecycle changes. Draft until CI and independent review.
